description_en: Retrieves the application status information of an edge container, including deployment, publishing, and rollback details
description_zh: 获取边缘容器的应用状态信息，包括应用的部署、发布、回滚等信息
kebab_example: aliyun esa get-edge-container-app-status --app-id app-880688675783790000 --publish-env staging --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEdgeContainerAppStatus

parameters.description_en: The application ID. You can call [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) to obtain the application ID. Before calling this operation, you must first activate the edge container service by calling OpenEdgeContainer, and then confirm that an available application exists by calling ListEdgeContainerApps or create an application by calling CreateEdgeContainerApp.
parameters.description_zh: 应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。调用该接口需先通过 OpenEdgeContainer 开通边缘容器服务，并通过 ListEdgeContainerApps 确认存在可用应用或通过 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用。
parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can call [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) to obtain the application ID. Before calling this operation, you must first activate the edge container service by calling OpenEdgeContainer, and then confirm that an available application exists by calling ListEdgeContainerApps or create an application by calling CreateEdgeContainerApp

parameters.name: app_id
